dict.string: Camera access is required to scan QR codes for Wi-Fi auto-configuration and for screen-safe proximity dimming while riding.
Kove Mirror requires Bluetooth to discover, connect, and sync telemetry data with your motorcycle's TFT dashboard.
Kove Mirror requires Bluetooth to connect with your motorcycle's TFT dashboard.
Kove Mirror needs Local Network access to connect and stream video to your motorcycle's dashboard over Wi-Fi.
Location access is required to display your position on the map and provide turn-by-turn navigation on your motorcycle dashboard.
Location access is required for background turn-by-turn navigation updates while riding.
